01aa462feb9c.text: Change the seed, and the weather rolls with the hero.

06b090554805.text: Randomize, the default, gives every run a new seed. Fixed keeps the same one, and plus one steps through seeds in order, so you can come back to any of them.

07326b46d038.text: Open it to rename it, edit the text, or give it a category, tags and a favourite star.

07b61ad32f1b.text: First, add WP Debug under the Context, so every run shows what it rolled.

082ff98fe74f.text: Character holds the Hero list, and three smaller bundles inside it: Look, Outfit and Shared lists.

106c4c910925.text: On the canvas, the constraint goes between the two lists: Hero, the constraint, then Setting.

110fa32584ae.text: Now the template only needs two names.

110fa7b0e3e9.text: SHOES is an accepts group. Its tags are alternatives: a robe goes with sandals or slippers, and each pick rolls one of them.

13cd23613d87.text: Each one rolls one option and keeps it in a variable: hero, outfit and setting.

13feee187e63.text: Click the lock again to let it roll.

1577b8b81b7d.text: And the gear opens the settings: themes, density, and how the canvas widgets look.

1594804181ff.text: On the canvas, a Context node picks Hero and Outfit first, then Style and the new Hero line.

166012658898.text: Drag a wire from context to context.

1a1f38f5c30a.text: Roll again. The hero stays, and the outfit and the setting keep changing.

1a54b7f2b666.text: This button sets what the seed does after each run.

1b4ab1b8b262.text: lighting becomes moonlight and a warm lantern glow.

1f61a094c1b7.text: Fixed values hold what never changes, combines build lines you reuse. Next: derivations.

2326db785937.text: The manager opens in its own window, on the dashboard.

26421a02d89b.text: Derivations set a variable by a rule, constraints keep picks that clash apart, and bundles group items together.

2660c2190195.text: Rules keep your picks making sense together. Next: constraints, which change the odds instead.

26c0e72a9fa0.text: This one reads the Hero and re-weights the Setting.

26f5ff32982a.text: Every option has a weight. The chance column shows how often each one rolls.

2c5fbd2a1c6e.text: Switch the street thief off. This change is only for this node: the Hero list in your library stays as it is.

2f6f96c67804.text: The badge marks a row that differs from the library. Reset overrides in the same window puts it back.

338d8373eb82.text: The sidebar lists your modules: the pieces a prompt is built from.

37b3e46e447c.text: A combine joins variables into one line you can reuse. Let's make one.

3851fb37568b.text: Travel gear has two groups. CLIMATE is descriptive: a coat is cold weather gear, a robe is warm. All of an option's descriptive tags count at once.

3bd0832aeac8.text: That's the basics of Wildcard Pipeline. The advanced videos go further: nested lists, LoRAs, loops and more.

3f9efb813688.text: Documentation explains every node, editor and setting, with pictures.

404b595aee9e.text: Save it, and it's in your library.

424fa9c34f31.text: Right-click a row for everything else you can do with it.

42ebae052f5d.text: Fold both to keep the node small.

4593f77bfe49.text: Change the seed until the time rolls night, and watch the lighting follow.

461526b748c8.text: Save keeps it on this node. Save to library would change the list everywhere.

4743c9d8a71d.text: From here you can start any new item in one click.

4b84f916ede4.text: Night brings the moonlight, and the negative output gets the rule's negative.

4e308a7941cf.text: Back on the canvas, add a Context node and pick Hero and Weather.

50f6f768cab2.text: On the canvas, a Context node takes a bundle just like a module. Click Add Bundle.

5352952d6267.text: Pick Character first, then Scene, because the scene's rule reads the hero.

540ace07a36b.text: Next, a WP Prompt Assembler. It writes the prompt.

55117a514962.text: Every variable from both bundles is ready to use. Roll a few seeds.

57c3de063bbb.text: The style stays put while the hero line rolls with every seed.

58e7c938f87e.text: The Assembler shows the prompt it will write, before you run anything.

58f52078d54c.text: Fold a frame, switch it off with its checkbox, or open an item to change it for this node only.

590497dcb5ec.text: Now the options: one per line. Each prompt rolls one of them.

5cf5da21ae39.text: Edit opens the item right here, with its options and their odds.

5d94340b0128.text: Now press Run a few times. Randomize gives each run a new seed, no clicking needed.

5dfbe441b399.text: Give it a name. The variable name follows on its own.

5fb2cbe57356.text: Tick Hero, Outfit and Setting, then add them.

6018cd8bb8fc.text: Your templates are listed here. Pick one.

61943d05f9dc.text: Give it a name. The preview shows what gets saved.

61ac7f7d4a2f.text: Wildcard Pipeline builds random prompts from lists you keep in a library. Let's make a first one.

64126e13325f.text: Each option lists the shoes it goes with.

66d3bbeafd33.text: Rows are the hero's tags, columns the setting's tags.

68da0984793f.text: Snow should be rare, so give it a weight of a half. Its chance drops, and the others share the rest.

6b28502ca8aa.text: A derivation sets a variable by a rule, instead of rolling it. Here is Lighting from time.

6b2ebc636880.text: On the canvas, pick Time of day and Setting, the rule, and Scene line, a combine that reads all three.

6f1da3098da0.text: Roll on every run, lock what you like, and change an item for one node without touching your library.

70108787aaf0.text: Lost? Select any Wildcard Pipeline node and press the question mark above it.

7427fca97898.text: A combine reads what was rolled above it, so the order matters.

7786b4c7decc.text: The disk button saves both to the library.

78e1b769f478.text: The roll happens once per run, so $gear.SHOES reads the same everywhere you write it.

7d8dcf11971e.text: Write a prompt once, save it, and load it into any Assembler. Next: bundles.

836924b6e384.text: And here they are as pictures: every hero where they belong.

85104ac21a40.text: Every saved template lives on the Templates page of the manager.

88f568cd701d.text: Only the scene line reaches the template, so hide the other three with their globe buttons. The combine still reads them.

93386c56c97d.text: A noble hero makes a castle four times as likely,

95fa2308979b.text: Open the negative box under it, too. A template keeps its negative with it.

9719ef12f3b0.text: Character brings the Hero list, then Look with the hair, eyes and colors, Outfit, and the Shared lists.

98fcdd0a1bd9.text: That's it: a new prompt for every seed. Next, we'll make a wildcard of our own.

9963393f5591.text: Roll a few seeds. Knights and mages land in castles more often, and the thief stays in the city.

99bfb5e4a815.text: Edit it, hold it for a whole batch, push it to the library, duplicate it, wrap it into a bundle, or move it.

9b7236360017.text: The scene line already reads the setting, the time and the lighting, and the hair list reads the colors. Hide those four with their globe buttons.

9c72f8c561d4.text: On the canvas, pick Hero and Travel gear.

9c736b37c1b1.text: Wildcard Pipeline adds a button to ComfyUI's top bar. It opens the manager, where your library lives.

9f69ea64d8b9.text: Add a Prompt Assembler, wire it up, and write the template.

a3aa31d03653.text: Here are a few of those scenes, run through a model.

a478c7e062d0.text: Hero and Outfit only feed the hero line now. Click the globe on their rows to hide them from the prompt.

a687e71df23a.text: Not everything should roll. A fixed value always writes the same text.

a8e131ac2101.text: Here's what those prompts make, run through a model.

a99e66d4c58c.text: It fills in the template and the negative. Edit it here freely: the saved copy doesn't change.

aa69b4ebf7ef.text: A second action adds a negative, so the night isn't overexposed.

b87a218300d1.text: Wildcards are lists to roll from. Fixed values always say the same thing. Combines join variables into a line.

ba2b54b678b8.text: Each bundle sits in its own frame. Open them to see what came in.

bc3eac1bb4b5.text: Constraints never block a run. They only change the odds, so your prompts make sense more often.

be215f0c5bb0.text: Fold both bundles to keep the node small.

be416c6e5a2c.text: Add WP Debug to see what each list picked when the workflow runs.

c1c2cfc38a01.text: Random picks can clash: a street thief in a royal throne room. A constraint changes the odds by what was already rolled.

c43be75daabb.text: Hero is a list of heroes. Open it to see its options.

c4a44182cabc.text: Once your lists work well together, keep them together. A bundle is a saved set of modules.

c659646078ad.text: Run through a model, every picture keeps the painted style.

c70902e4d7fb.text: The switch on the group's header sets its kind.

c9aeb816d168.text: Like this hero? Lock it. The lock button keeps the seed it rolled.

cacfd5b6844f.text: and an urban hero never gets a castle at all.

ce6940f32ead.text: Scene brings the setting, the time of day, the lighting rule, the scene line and the style.

d0a2ac7b1137.text: Your own lists work just like the ones you install. Next: fixed values and combines.

d0cf8fcede6d.text: The combine still reads them, so the prompt stays the same. On their own, they no longer print anywhere.

d2292d43a7b7.text: Tags are short words on an option. On their own they filter and steer picks. Put them in groups and they can do more.

d29089a454c9.text: Roll a few seeds. The shoes always fit the gear: never sandals with a fur cloak.

d2d2087d49e9.text: A Context node holds the lists that roll. Add module picks them from your library.

d36a98b741ac.text: Each bundle sits in its own frame. Fold it, switch it off with its checkbox, or open it to change one item for this node only.

d48848da457b.text: Now a second Assembler. Wire it to the same Context and open the folder button.

d4eef3de5ae2.text: Let's make a wildcard for the weather. In the manager, open Wildcards and press New Wildcard.

d50e0a5da117.text: Its help page opens right over the canvas.

d969a6f6fab7.text: Debug shows what each run rolled. No street thief, on this node.

d9e69f144151.text: That's the tour. Next, we'll make a wildcard of our own.

dbc29d718c08.text: So far we rolled by clicking plus. The Context node can roll for you.

dc55de5e786a.text: The scene line reads the setting, the time and the lighting, so hide those three too, and fold Scene.

de9f4c1999b3.text: It writes a new variable, hero line, from a small template of its own.

e3269bd8e7cc.text: In the template, $gear.SHOES prints the shoe that was rolled with the gear.

e443a24ea63a.text: Double-click the canvas and search for WP Context.

e45cc48a0969.text: Tags sort options into groups, like noble or urban. Rules can read them later.

e779341f3c23.text: Bundles can nest, so you build big sets out of small ones and reuse the small ones anywhere.

e99c3c741bab.text: Debug shows the picks behind the last picture, so you can see the prompt change from run to run.

ef02a1e32300.text: Type a template. Each dollar-sign name is replaced by what its list rolled.

f0f12a8d4482.text: Accepts groups also let constraints match tag for tag, and tags filter references inside wildcards. Both come next.

f5b117624e40.text: Change the seed, and every list rolls again.

f9a5d8143a7c.text: Any other time gets soft natural light.

f9ed444fa84e.text: This one sets style to a painting look, and it carries a negative too.

fbd797ce07e7.text: A template is the sentence the Assembler fills in. Once you like one, keep it in your library.

fc506693480a.text: Debug lists every variable and the option it rolled.

fe48b0868bdd.text: The hair list already reads the colors, so hide Colors with its globe button. Then fold the frame.
